purpose: Determine whether existing historical E reconstruction can support a materially new V2.9 development-only evidence-anchored candidate path without reopening V2.8.12R or consuming fold3/fold4.

reasons: Eight historical windows were frozen before real candidate query.
Discovery used the frozen V2.8.4 18-term registry, frozen triage and page-scoped classifier.
Selection was deterministic by SHA256(announcement_id), capped per window, security-diverse, and manual security/document selection was forbidden.
Positive-yield resampling and window shifting were forbidden.
No security price, return, fold3 or fold4 data were consumed.

Retry2 was a bounded in-place repair of a source-orchestration/receipt defect in the already-frozen 2023Q3 window; it did not change keywords, classifier, triage, windows, density thresholds or candidate rules.
v2811_method_audit.decision: Reuse the deterministic source-construction method, not the sparse V2.8.11 sample as a strategy-development dataset.

development_universe_boundary.principle: New historical E discovery may scan public announcements broadly, but a filing may enter the V2.9 development dataset only if its canonical_security_id belongs to one of the already-consumed frozen development manifests fold0, fold1 or fold2.
development_universe_boundary.manifest_overlap_rule: Implementation validation must prove the three admitted manifests are pairwise disjoint by canonical_security_id before any real source query; otherwise fail closed.

price_source_boundary.source_invalid_handling: If outcome research is authorized later, preserve source-invalid status and fail closed for that security; no replacement or alternate-security substitution.
